title: first100-exec-state
description: Anti-drift execution-state anchor for the First-100 program (maintainer decision C2). Lives at spec/first100/exec/EXEC-STATE.json on the first100-exec branch. Written ONLY by the Supervisor, ONLY at slice boundaries (never mid-slice, never by a Writer/Reviewer subagent). Read first on every session start and every post-compact resume, before trusting any chat memory. EXEC-STATE, the ledger, and command-freeze.json must never disagree; any inconsistency between them is BLOCKED, not auto-resolved.

activeWorktree.description: Absolute realpath of the git worktree this state belongs to. Every session's first action verifies `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` equals this.

activeBranch.description: The sole execution branch. No product-code write ever happens on any other branch during the program.

frozenBaselineSha.description: Must equal tests/first100/registry.json's frozenBaseline.sha. A mismatch is BLOCKED.

currentWave.description: 0 = W0 bootstrap slice; 1-19 = the registry's wave range; 20-22 = P9-01..09 extension waves (gated on the Stage-0 registry extension, decision C3).

currentSlice.description: The slice in flight, or null between slices (no slice open).

step.description: Per-slice-flow step (maintainer decision, Step 2 a-f: SPEC-FREEZE / RED / GREEN / REVIEW / greening / persisted).

registryDigest.description: sha256 of the committed tests/first100/registry.json at last EXEC-STATE write.

ledgerDigest.description: sha256 of the committed spec/first100/exec/ledger.json at last EXEC-STATE write.

blockedQueueRef.description: Path to the parked-BLOCKED-items log (24x7 mode, decision C6 item 4).

programGate.description: Fixed truth: only 100/100 registry ACCEPTED + R10 passed is GO. Never any other value while acceptedEpics < 100.
